screenshots.notes: Second-area build selects the local truck; previous area's workers remain assigned to their earlier job.
Local Factory Module queues behind the second area's tower with the local truck highlighted.
Returning to the first area uses its original two trucks for a lab module.
Native completed lab/tower visible; temporary placement outlines clear.
The actual native single-truck selection is reflected in the compact Build panel and unit highlight.
Android Back shows the exact requested native confirmation and Cancel/Return, with no stock pause menu.
Repeated confirmation remains readable and consistent.
Actual Android keyboard shown before Back.
Keyboard dismissal leaves the full Design layout readable; page closure is verified separately by native/JS state.
After repeated Cancel, the Queue page opens normally and lists completed independent work.
Confirmed Return opens the original map/start menu directly.
A fresh battle remains usable after its own Back confirmation and Cancel.

limitations: The emulator's existing black terrain limits ground-texture visual verification; physical Android devices were not tested.
The confirmation blocks game input while open. The battle simulation continues; this change does not introduce a new pause mechanism.

Live checks used real authored Dustfall groups and modules. Iron Valley and every structure were not replayed in this focused change; source tests cover shared selection logic and the native payload/maps remain unchanged.

Actual single-truck selection used the purpose-built native selection-click API with real native state/ID verification; construction, camera changes and menu controls used real ADB touches. Manual-clear safety is covered by focused source regressions.
